description: Bump a package version and add a changelog entry

steps.send: Release 1.5.0: change the version from 1.4.2 to 1.5.0 everywhere it is set, and add a `## 1.5.0` section at the top of CHANGELOG.md (above 1.4.2) with the line `- Added: --json output.`

graders.run: python3 -c "t=open('CHANGELOG.md').read(); assert '- Added: --json output.' in t and t.index('## 1.5.0') < t.index('## 1.4.2') < t.index('## 1.4.1'), t"
graders.name: changelog order
